saw_lines: Buyers of a new car research for weeks, comparing models, trims and dealers across tabs before they book a test drive.
So the visit is won or lost in the first line of the ad, the moment the buyer decides to keep reading.
Your 30 live ads include no video, so buyers never see the car move. Shoot three short videos of the Familien-SUV in use and test each against your current ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Nov 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads is a video, so static shots lose buyers who scroll past. Shoot three videos of the Familien-SUV in use, a family loading the boot, a drive through town, then test each against your current ads.

None of your 10 ads with written copy carries a proof number, so a buyer comparing dealers has no reason to pick you. Collect one figure, such as reviews received or cars delivered, and open every Get offer ad with it.
20 of your 30 live ads are feed ads with no story, so buyers scroll past a list. Add three story ads, starting with the flexible interior, the family SUV for seven and the BMW Panoramic iDrive.

3 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not to a car, so the click lands among every brand you sell. Point each one to the model page its creative shows, so the next screen matches the ad.

ads_1: Short video ads of the Familien-SUV and flexible interior, tested against current copy
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and YouTube
